# ROBO vs BOTZ ETF: A Comparison for Portfolios
## Key Takeaways
- Year-to-date through July 21, ROBO returned 14.5% compared to -3.9% for BOTZ, driven by divergent geographic and stock-specific allocations.

## Return Dynamics and Volatility
Year-to-date through July 21, ROBO has posted a 14.5% return, whereas BOTZ has dropped 3.9%. Over a one-year period, ROBO gained 29.6% against BOTZ’s 5.8% gain.

Over the last five years, ROBO recorded an annualized volatility of 20.3%, compared to 22.7% for BOTZ.
